description: Returns a signed receipt {sha256, stamped_at, key_id, signature, public_key_url}: a booklint-family service saw this hash at stamped_at, signed with key key_id. Send ONLY a SHA-256 hex digest (64 characters). We never see or store the document — only the hash you send. This is not legal proof, notary service, evidence, or a certificate of anything. Not advice.

api_key.description: Optional key. Same as the Bearer header.

name: stamp_hash
title: Stamp a SHA-256 hash
